source_summary: Vertical Chinese ink-and-wash landscape with layered rocky mountains, mist, a small village compound, bridge and stream, pine and bamboo groves, foreground riverbank, and a lone boatman. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from the motif bank.

motifs.name: upper_craggy_peak
motifs.description: Isolate the high upper-right mountain peak cluster rising out of mist, with rounded eroded rock faces, dark dotted vegetation along ridgelines, and pale ink-wash slopes fading toward the right.
must_preserve: fine contour lines defining the rounded rock ribs
dark clustered tree dots and short vertical strokes along the crest
soft gray-brown wash texture on the upper slopes
mist-softened lower edge where the peak dissolves into blank space

motifs.name: central_forested_mountain_massif
motifs.description: Isolate the large central mountain mass with overlapping rounded hills, dense forest band on the upper right, and dark stippled shrubs following the ridges and gullies.
must_preserve: layered contour-line rock texture on each rounded slope
dense vertical tree strokes and black dot foliage in the forest band
ink-wash gradations separating near ridges from misty recesses
dark stipple clusters tracing the ridge edges and ravines

motifs.name: left_waterfall_gorge
motifs.description: Isolate the left-side rocky gorge below the middle mountains, including the narrow falling waterfall, flanking boulders, sparse brush, and mist at the base.
must_preserve: thin vertical waterfall lines descending through the rocks
cracked rock contour strokes on both sides of the gorge
dark mossy dots and short grasses clinging to ledges
soft blank mist around the waterfall base

motifs.name: village_compound
motifs.description: Isolate the small village compound nestled below the mountains, including tiled boundary wall, gate, clustered roof planes, courtyard lines, and adjacent dark trees that frame the buildings.
must_preserve: precise roof geometry and angled eaves
repeated tile pattern on the enclosing wall
fine architectural linework of gates, rooms, and courtyard divisions
dark leafy tree masses partly overlapping the buildings

motifs.name: right_pine_rock_slope
motifs.description: Isolate the right hillside beside the village, with tall pine and slender trunks, dense vertical grove texture, and rounded foreground rocks at the base.
must_preserve: tiered pine needles and horizontal branch structure
thin vertical trunk lines of the grove
rounded boulder outlines with striated rock texture
dark stippled moss and shrub dots around the rocks

motifs.name: arched_bridge_stream_crossing
motifs.description: Isolate the small arched bridge and stream crossing below the village, including the rail-like bridge strokes, shallow watercourse, scattered stones, and lightly washed path edges.
must_preserve: delicate bridge outline and simple rail posts
curving stream-edge lines
small dark stepping stones and ground marks
pale wash suggesting the open path around the crossing

motifs.name: foreground_riverbank_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the foreground central-right riverbank grove with tall leafy trees, bamboo-like foliage, slim trunks, pine needles at the right edge, and the rocky bank beneath them.
must_preserve: fine leaf clusters and bamboo-like narrow leaves
dark ink accents in the tree crowns
slender trunks and branching structure
needle strokes on the right-side pine
rounded shoreline rocks with layered contour texture and stippled moss

motifs.name: lone_boatman_skiff
motifs.description: Isolate the small boat at lower left on open water, including the seated boatman, woven canopy or cargo texture, pointed hull, paddle shape, and faint surrounding ripples.
must_preserve: curved pointed skiff outline
tiny seated boatman silhouette and hat-like head form
crosshatched woven texture inside the boat
slender paddle or pole line
faint ink ripple arcs around the hull

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
